source.citation: Rockström J, Thilsted SH, Willett WC, Gordon LJ, Herrero M, Hicks CC, Mason-D'Croz D, Rao N, Springmann M, Wright EC, et al. The EAT-Lancet Commission on healthy, sustainable, and just food systems. Lancet. 2025;406(10510):1625-1700.

per_capita_derivation.rationale: We divide the global limit evenly across roughly 8 billion people. This is a simple way to ask "is this meal a lot?"; it isn't a fair-share rule. In real life the wealthiest third of the world drives most food-system pressures.

boundaries.label: Climate change
boundaries.current_food_system_contribution: 16–17.7 Gt CO₂e/yr (about 30 % of all human emissions)
boundaries.method_note: Production-stage CO₂-equivalent emissions, weighted across CO₂, methane, and N₂O over 100 years.

boundaries.label: Land system change
boundaries.control_variable: Agricultural land area (current footprint, no further conversion of intact nature)
boundaries.global_boundary_unit: m² (stock, treated as m²·yr/yr proportional cut)
boundaries.global_boundary_source: Hold today's agricultural land area; halt conversion of remaining intact nature
boundaries.method_note: The published target is an absolute area to hold, not a per-meal flux. We compare each meal's land-use footprint (m²·yr per serving) to one person's daily share of the world's agricultural land. The target asks not to expand, so this share is best read as an attribution rather than a strict limit.

boundaries.label: Blue water consumption
boundaries.method_note: Blue (irrigation) water use, weighted by how scarce water is in the producing region. The recommended limit is a single global number; we divide it equally across people for comparison.

boundaries.label: Biosphere integrity (HANPP)
boundaries.control_variable: Human appropriation of net primary production
boundaries.current_food_system_contribution: 9.9–11.7 Gt of carbon per year (about three-quarters of the global total)
boundaries.reason_unavailable: We don't yet have per-food data for global biodiversity loss. Available life-cycle datasets capture local land use, not the global biosphere impact this target measures.

boundaries.label: Stratospheric ozone (N₂O)
boundaries.global_boundary_source: 1.8 Tg of nitrous-oxide nitrogen per year
boundaries.current_food_system_contribution: 3.9–4.2 Tg per year (roughly two-thirds of the global total)
boundaries.reason_unavailable: Per-food nitrous-oxide data exists in the source life-cycle catalogue but isn't yet wired into our pipeline. Planned for a later release.

boundaries.label: Ocean acidification
boundaries.control_variable: CO₂ from food-chain land-use change + fossil energy
boundaries.global_boundary_source: Zero food-chain CO₂ from clearing land and burning fossil fuels
boundaries.reason_unavailable: Our environmental method doesn't include a separate ocean-acidification measure. The recommended limit also distinguishes between fuel-burning and land-clearing emissions, which our per-food data doesn't currently separate.

boundaries.label: Nitrogen surplus
boundaries.global_boundary_source: 57 Tg of nitrogen per year (less than half today's rate)
boundaries.reason_unavailable: Nitrogen surplus isn't yet available as a per-food number in our data. Eutrophication numbers come close but measure local water pollution, not the global nitrogen surplus this target tracks.

boundaries.label: Phosphorus loss to surface water
boundaries.control_variable: P loss from agricultural land to surface water
boundaries.global_boundary_source: 4.6 Tg of phosphorus reaching surface water per year
boundaries.current_food_system_contribution: 7.2 Tg per year (about three-quarters of the global total)
boundaries.reason_unavailable: Per-food phosphorus-loss numbers are available in the source life-cycle data but not yet active in our pipeline. Planned for a later release.

boundaries.label: Novel entities (pesticides)
boundaries.global_boundary_unit: kg PAS/yr (1 Tg high-risk avoidance; 0.2 Tg low risk)
boundaries.global_boundary_source: Cut total pesticide use to 1 Tg per year (or 0.2 Tg for the most harmful)
boundaries.current_food_system_contribution: 3.3–3.7 Tg per year (most of global pesticide use)
boundaries.reason_unavailable: Our life-cycle data doesn't track pesticide use by product. This category would need a different data source.
